params.name: carrierCodes
params.description: Comma-separated list of airline carrier codes to filter flights (e.g., TB,OR,X3)

params.name: departureStationCodes
params.description: Comma-separated list of departure airport codes to filter flights (e.g., BRU,LHR,MAN)

params.name: arrivalStationCodes
params.description: Comma-separated list of arrival airport codes to filter flights (e.g., ACE,LPA,PMI)

params.name: departureCountries
params.description: Comma-separated list of departure country codes to filter flights (e.g., GB,DE,BE)

params.name: arrivalCountries
params.description: Comma-separated list of arrival country codes to filter flights (e.g., ES,FR,IT)

params.name: outboundStartDate
params.description: Start date of the search range for outbound flights. Use this with OutboundEndDate to search flights within a date range. Format: yyyy-MM-dd (e.g., 2024-06-01)

params.name: outboundEndDate
params.description: End date of the search range for outbound flights. Use this with OutboundStartDate to search flights within a date range. Format: yyyy-MM-dd (e.g., 2024-12-31)

params.name: inboundStartDate
params.description: Start date of the search range for inbound/return flights. Use this with InboundEndDate to search return flights within a date range. Format: yyyy-MM-dd (e.g., 2024-06-15)

params.name: inboundEndDate
params.description: End date of the search range for inbound/return flights. Use this with InboundStartDate to search return flights within a date range. Format: yyyy-MM-dd (e.g., 2024-07-31)

params.name: PassengerCount
params.description: Number of passengers for availability check (default: 1)

params.name: LimitGroups
params.description: Maximum number of flight groups to return in the response

params.name: LimitFlights
params.description: Maximum number of flights to return per group in the response

params.name: GroupBy
params.description: Grouping strategy for results: 0 = OriginDestination, 1 = Date
